name.text: Integration by u substitution of a definite Integral

questiontext.text:
Evaluate the following definite integral using the substitution method:

\(\displaystyle \int^{@rdm1@}_{@rdm2@} {@p@} d{@v@}\)

Hint: Use the substitution \(u = {@pp2@}\)


[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
We need to solve \(\displaystyle \int {@p@} d{@v@}\) using the substitution \(u = {@pp2@}\) [[facts:calc_int_methods_substitution]].

So, if \(u = {@pp2@}\), then \({@v@} = {@q@}\) and \(d{@v@} = {@diff(q,u)@}d{@u@}\).

Hence,

\(\begin{align} \displaystyle \int {@p@} d{@v@} &=\displaystyle \int [{@subst(q,v,p)@}] {@diff(q,u)@}d{@u@} \\ &=\displaystyle \int [{@expand(subst(q,v,p)*diff(q,u))@} d{@u@} \\ & =\displaystyle {@int(expand(subst(q,v,p)*diff(q,u)),u)@}+c \\ & =\displaystyle {@subst(pp2,u,int(expand(subst(q,v,p)*diff(q,u)),u))@}+c\\ \end{align}\)

We need \(\displaystyle \int^{@rdm1@}_{@rdm2@} {@p@} d{@v@} \)

So, recall that if \(\displaystyle \int f(x) dx = F(x)+c\) then \(\displaystyle \int^a_b f(x) dx = F(a) - F(b).\)

So, let \(F({@v@}) = {@subst(pp2,u,int(expand(subst(q,v,p)*diff(q,u)),u))@}\)

Then,

\(\begin{align} \displaystyle \int^{@rdm1@}_{@rdm2@} {@p@} d{@v@} & =\displaystyle F({@rdm1@}) - F({@rdm2@}) \\ & =\displaystyle {@subst(rdm1,v,subst(pp2,u,int(expand(subst(q,v,p)*diff(q,u)),u)))@}-{@subst(rdm2,v,subst(pp2,u,int(expand(subst(q,v,p)*diff(q,u)),u)))@} \\ &=\displaystyle {@subst(rdm1,v,subst(pp2,u,int(expand(subst(q,v,p)*diff(q,u)),u)))-subst(rdm2,v,subst(pp2,u,int(expand(subst(q,v,p)*diff(q,u)),u)))@}\\ \end{align}\)

Hence,

\(\begin{align} \displaystyle \int^{@rdm1@}_{@rdm2@} {@p@} d{@v@} &=\displaystyle F({@rdm1@}) - F({@rdm2@}) \\ &=\displaystyle {@subst(rdm1,v,subst(pp2,u,int(expand(subst(q,v,p)*diff(q,u)),u)))@}-{@subst(rdm2,v,subst(pp2,u,int(expand(subst(q,v,p)*diff(q,u)),u)))@} \\ &=\displaystyle {@subst(rdm1,v,subst(pp2,u,int(expand(subst(q,v,p)*diff(q,u)),u)))-subst(rdm2,v,subst(pp2,u,int(expand(subst(q,v,p)*diff(q,u)),u)))@}\\ \end{align}\)
